ctx.x: Was this The Buddy Holly Story.

It was The Buddy Holly Story. But that one was cancelled, because Buddy Holly's widow didn't... They hadn't gotten things straight with her, and she had an attorney, and after they had spent a couple of million dollars they scrubbed the whole project. And later Paramount did the story.
Did they go ahead and make the picture, and then...
